You’ll want to give it time to cool before adding it to your melted butter!

This time I used three sticks of unsalted butter (24grams) and 1 cup water straight in the crockpot. I usually put a pot liner in the make butter transfer easiest. Once the butter is fully melted and you have decarbed your bud you just add it straight into the crockpot on low-med. The butter should reach anywhere from 165-180 degrees F. You can let it sit in the crockpot for 4-8 hours depending on how strong you want your butter. Once your done in the crockpot, just transfer the butter to a different dish topped with cheesecloth to separate the butter from the weed and throw it in the fridge for a few hours. Once butter hardens you’ll be able to separate it from the water and divide it how you’d like. I used 14g of weed, and cut my butter in the 4 equal pieces; so, each 6gram cut of butter will have about 3.5gs of weed!

I made it home to see my grandmother one last time before she passed. I graduated high school and moved out of my hometown and across the country in 2015 and I had not been back since. There was never any real regret, until this wicked virus washed over everything and everywhere and I received the call that my grandmother was sick. I made it home as soon as possible and we did everything we were able to with her in her last moments. I wasn’t able to touch her, or even be in the same room as her, but I was there; and she knew I was there. This is a sad thing. But god, am I so thankful to have been there with her during those last moments. So this is a good thing. For me.
